title: 2026 AMC 8 Problem 16
statement: Consider all positive four-digit integers consisting of only even digits. What fraction of these integers are divisible by \(4?\)

solutions.text: There are \(4\) choices for the thousands digit and \(5\) choices for each other digit. Divisibility by \(4\) depends only on the last two digits. Among the \(25\) even digit endings, for each tens digit \(0,2,4,6,8\), the ones digit can be \(0,4,8\), so \(15\) endings work. The desired fraction is \(\frac{15}{25}=\frac{3}{5}\).
hints: Divisibility by \(4\) depends only on the last two digits
For each tens digit, the ones digit must be \(0\), \(4\), or \(8\)
